newsitem.title: USA: USDA - soybeans, meal sold to China in Dec 19 wk.
newsitem.headline: USDA - soybeans, meal sold to China in Dec 19 wk.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday said net soybean sales to China in the week ended December 19 totalled 55,000 tonnes and that soymeal sales were 50,000 tonnes.
In its weekly export sales report, the department also said net soyoil sales to China in the week of December 19 were 5,000 tonnes, all destination changes.
USDA said the soybean activity included 5,000 tonnes in new sales and 50,000 tonnes in destination changes.
